{{Capricorn}}
Capricorn 13 is the 41st day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 13th day of Capricorn, and it is a Saturday. It corresponds to ISO week 6, weekday 6.

Its informal Japanese name is 2宮13日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 41|Chapter 41]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152061}}.

[[Category:Days with weekday Saturday]]
[[Category:Days 13 of the Gaian calendar]]
[[Category:Days of Capricorn]]

=== 12026 meditations ===
Today I took double my normal dose of Vyvannse (40mg) and I am trying to lock in. I made my bed for the tiny task thing, although I really do not think it is that helpful since I am not culturally conditioned to make my bed.
